answer: Bonded stake at the bridge: each identity locks 500 tokens; slashing burns 100% on proven sybil linkage. Velvet smooths onboarding — new nodes post 2x collateral for 30 epochs, decaying to 1x. This asymmetric cost makes n identities cost 500n + penalty, while honest yield stays flat. An oasis of trust emerges: forging 10 IDs risks 5,000 tokens vs ~50 in rewards, so expected value goes negative. Sybils die because collateral exceeds any plausible gain.
